Red Bull Racing.summary: Red Bull has tweaked the front wing to give the car a little extra bite in the corners, letting it generate more down‑force exactly where it’s needed for better grip. They’ve also opened up the top of the engine cover to improve airflow and keep the power unit cooler, reducing the risk of reliability hiccups. Together, the changes should translate into quicker lap times and a smoother, more trouble‑free run this weekend.

Mercedes F1 Team.summary: Mercedes has tweaked the shape of the front wing flap, giving it a slightly different profile. This change smooths the airflow over the front of the car, boosting grip and making the car feel more balanced through the high‑speed corners of this weekend’s circuit. In short, the car should be quicker out of the bends and easier to drive on the straights.
